Report: Israeli drone strike wounds 14 in southern Gaza Strip

en.title: Israeli drone strike wounds 14 in southern Gaza Strip
en.dek: Fourteen people were injured by an Israeli drone strike in southern Gaza, reported on 30 October 2026.
facts: 14 people were wounded by an Israeli drone strike in southern Gaza Strip, according to Haaretz.
The strike was reported on 30 October 2026, according to Haaretz.
The drone was operated by the Israeli Defense Forces, according to Haaretz.
The incident occurred in the southern Gaza Strip, an area that has seen frequent military activity, according to Haaretz.
body: On 30 October 2026, Haaretz reported that an Israeli drone strike wounded 14 people in the southern Gaza Strip. The strike was carried out by a drone operated by the Israeli Defense Forces. The wounded were located in the southern Gaza Strip, an area that has seen frequent military activity. The report did not specify the exact location within the southern Gaza Strip.

The Gaza Strip has been the site of ongoing conflict between Israel and Palestinian groups. The region has experienced severe food shortages, as noted by the Hind Rajab Foundation. The foundation has filed complaints against Israeli soldiers for alleged war crimes in Gaza. These allegations highlight the broader tensions in the area.

The Haaretz article did not provide casualty details beyond the number wounded. It also did not mention any fatalities. The report did not identify the target of the strike, nor did it provide details on the drone model or mission objectives.
en.context: The Gaza Strip has been the focus of repeated Israeli military operations, including drone strikes, as part of the broader conflict with Palestinian groups. The region has experienced severe food shortages, according to the Hind Rajab Foundation. The foundation has filed complaints against Israeli soldiers for alleged war crimes in Gaza.
